notes.heading: Comparing
notes.text: Toggle the reference against either render. The previous render is the dist-gated recreation of the 40T pulley, and the revised one draws the print fits listed in 720-003_DiffEndPulley.scad's header: the rod bore takes the press clearance, and the rim moves out to the 80T GT2 ring with the hub, flanges and web heights unchanged, so only the previous render is expected to match the reference's rim. Run render.rs --verify before building this page, because the renders are its output.
